scenes.line2: How does it boost UI speed?
scenes.say: Ever wondered why Fabric makes React Native apps feel smoother? What’s behind its speed boost?

scenes.label: Concurrent
scenes.sub: Fabric schedules UI updates without blocking the JavaScript thread.
scenes.say: Fabric lets UI updates happen alongside JavaScript, so your app stays responsive even under heavy loads.
Fabric batches view updates, calculates layouts efficiently, and manages memory better. That’s perfect for complex screens.

scenes.question: What’s Fabric’s main impact?
scenes.wrong: It just changes the rendering engine.
scenes.right: It enables concurrent rendering and faster, scalable UI updates.
scenes.say: Don’t just say Fabric swaps engines. It’s about concurrent rendering and scalable, faster UI updates.
